bible.summary: Heaven's gate on clouds, grand: a huge pearly gate fills the frame height — two tall pearl pillars with gold capitals, pearl inlays and laurel wreaths, a pearl arch with a gold keystone and filigree curls, a gold sunburst grille, the gold gate leaves stand ajar and bright light pours through onto golden steps and a golden path on the cloud floor; behind it a city of clouds with spires, domes and golden onion towers in two depth layers, tiny distant angels and doves, sun rays; Saint Peter's reception lectern with a big open book, bookmarks, a quill in an inkpot and a desk bell on the left, a golden harp leaning on the right pillar, a big cloud on the right (and variants hell, garden of Eden, space, crossroads of souls): Saint Peter jokes.

variants.change: Red cave: stalactites, hanging chains, glowing cracks, lava falls and a lava lake at the back, flames along the walls, flying sparks, a boiling cauldron on a fire on the right, a pitchfork leaning on the left wall.

Lush garden: blue sky with sun rays and a faint rainbow, two ranges of snowy mountains, a waterfall from a cliff into a lake, hills with round trees and cypresses, a deer on the hill, a lion lying next to a lamb at the back centre, a stream; a big apple tree full of red apples with the serpent on a branch on the right and a peacock with an open tail in front of it; a palm tree and flowering bushes on the left, a rabbit, flowers in the grass, butterflies, a flock of birds.

Space: starry sky with nebulae and the Milky Way, a spiral galaxy, a ringed planet with a moon, the Earth, a satellite, a shooting star; grey moon surface with craters and rocks, a small rocket on the left, footprints and a little flag.

Crossroads in the clouds: a pale road comes from the viewer to a fork at the back centre, where the judge of souls stands (judge) between golden scales on a cloud pedestal (a feather and a heart on the pans, left of him) and a golden lectern with the open book of souls, a quill and inkpot (right of him); behind him a tall signpost with two big arrow boards without words: up-left a white-and-gold board with a winged halo and a cloud, down-right a charred dark red board with a pitchfork and a flame; the left branch is a wide golden stairway with pearl-topped railings climbing high to a pearly gate of paradise on a cloud island in golden rays with doves and tiny angels, a golden lantern with a halo sign at its foot (left-road at its foot); the right branch is dark cobblestone with glowing cracks leading to a fiery hole in the clouds with flames, dark steps going down, smoke and sparks, a crooked post with a flame sign pointing down (right-road at its start); souls stand at center, front-left, front-center, front-right.

bible.prompt: pearly gates on fluffy clouds, soft sky, golden light
